## What this notebook checks

Determine how variation in time-of-day exposure patterns is associated with
sites, participants, and days. Account for the fact that measurements close
together in time tend to be similar, a pattern called autocorrelation. Do not
describe variation in fitted model terms as the proportion of observed
variation explained.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: the prepared H02 dataset in `artifacts/06_model_data/H02.rds`.
- Produces: the selected time-of-day models; clearly defined summaries of
  variation among sites, participants, and days; model checks; model
  comparisons with 95% confidence intervals; the exact participants,
  participant-days, 30-minute observations, and sites used by each model,
  overall and by site;
  figures; tables; and their exact source data.
- Dependency: H11 will use only the temporal model selected and checked here.
- Data sensitivity: fit this identical H02 implementation to the
  manuscript-prepared dataset and compare exact model samples, estimates, 95%
  confidence intervals, diagnostics, and conclusions with the main analysis.
